macros.name: atomicnumber
macros.doc: Prints the atomic number of a given element.

macros.name: elconf
macros.doc: Typesets the electron configuration of the given element.

macros.name: elementname
macros.doc: Prints the element name of a given element as defined with \setatomname.

macros.name: elementsymbol
macros.doc: Prints the element symbol of a given element as defined with \setatomsymbol.

macros.name: saveatomicnumber
macros.doc: Saves the atomic number of the given element as replacement text for the macro ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: saveelementisotopes
macros.doc: Saves the isotope list of the given element as replacement text for the macro ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: saveelementname
macros.doc: Saves the name of the given element as replacement text for the macro ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: saveelementsymbol
macros.doc: Saves the symbol of the given element as replacement text for the macro ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: savemainelementisotope
macros.doc: Saves the main isotope of the given element as replacement text for the macro ⟨cs⟩.

macros.name: setatomisotopes
macros.doc: Defines or redefines the isotope list for a given element.

macros.name: setatomname
macros.doc: Define or redefine the name of an element.

macros.name: setatomsymbol
macros.doc: Define or redefine the symbol of an element.

macros.name: Z
macros.doc: An alias of \atomicnumber but only defined at begin document and only if it isn’t defined already.
